shortDescription: Member check-in result view with switchable membership states.
fullDescription: Home route rendering the gym member check-in result screen. It includes a front-desk header, an interactive member number search field, configurable result presentation for the success-active-member, payment-invalid-past-due, and membership-cancelled-access-denied states, member details, amenity tiles, a status banner, and local state controls for switching between supported check-in outcomes.
